title: Bond polygons and the excess at the weave's rim
claim: On a weave patch without holes: every tight cyclic order of a bond of m members has D-sum exactly 3(m - 2), each member on a D-geodesic between its neighbours (Lemma P); the excess e = b - steps - 1 equals (W - D(x,y) - D(y,x))/3 for the least bond's polygon weight W; a least bond's members lie within detour 3e of the round trip (Lemma C); hence an exact bond search without state enumeration. The figure-eight structure of bonds through opposite lone pairs is the advisor's sketch, not claimed.
standard_statement: Heights of the triangular antiferromagnet; difference constraints; minimal non-shattered sets.
